description: Na₂Ba₃Cr₄F₂₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.71 Å. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.09 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.67-3.13 Å. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-43°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.92-1.98 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-43°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.00 Å. There are ten inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Cr atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, and one Cr atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Cr atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Cr atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Cr atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Ba and one Cr atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Cr atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Cr atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Cr atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded to one Na, two Ba, and one Cr atom to form distorted corner-sharing FBa₂NaCr tetrahedra.
